list.query:
WITH (SELECT groupArray(tuple(region, cloud_provider, bucket, generation)) FROM (SELECT c.region, c.cloud_provider, c.bucket, c.generation FROM
 (SELECT region, cloud_provider, bucket, max(commits.generation) generation, argMax(commits.revision, commits.generation) revision
  FROM benchmark_rollup_commits AS commits
  WHERE bucket + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE > $__fromTime_ms AND bucket < $__toTime_ms
  AND ((bucket >= $__fromTime_ms AND bucket + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE <= $__toTime_ms) OR bucket < now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR) GROUP BY region, cloud_provider, bucket) c
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT region, cloud_provider, bucket, sum(revision) revision, sum(expected) expected, sum(incomplete) incomplete FROM benchmark_dirty_minutes
  WHERE bucket + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE > $__fromTime_ms AND bucket < $__toTime_ms
  AND ((bucket >= $__fromTime_ms AND bucket + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE <= $__toTime_ms) OR bucket < now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR) GROUP BY region, cloud_provider, bucket) d
 ON c.region = d.region AND c.cloud_provider = d.cloud_provider AND c.bucket = d.bucket
 WHERE c.revision >= d.revision AND d.revision >= d.expected AND d.incomplete = 0)) AS rollup_generations
 SELECT * FROM (WITH observed AS (
 SELECT subscription_id, data_type, min(first_seen) AS first_seen, max(last_seen) AS last_seen
 FROM (SELECT region, cloud_provider, subscription_id, data_type, commitment, provider,
 first_seen, last_seen FROM benchmark_minute_rollups
 WHERE kind = 'provider' AND region = ${region:sqlstring} AND cloud_provider = ${cloud_provider:sqlstring}
 AND (${data_type:sqlstring} = '__all' OR data_type = ${data_type:sqlstring}) AND commitment = ${commitment:sqlstring} AND (region, cloud_provider, bucket, generation) IN (SELECT tupleElement(r, 1), tupleElement(r, 2), tupleElement(r, 3), tupleElement(r, 4)
 FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(rollup_generations) AS r))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT region, cloud_provider, subscription_id, data_type, commitment, provider,
 min(event_utc) AS first_seen, max(event_utc) AS last_seen
 FROM benchmark_event_lags WHERE region = ${region:sqlstring} AND cloud_provider = ${cloud_provider:sqlstring}
 AND (${data_type:sqlstring} = '__all' OR data_type = ${data_type:sqlstring}) AND commitment = ${commitment:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter_ms(event_utc) AND (region, cloud_provider, toStartOfMinute(event_utc)) IN (
 SELECT region, cloud_provider, toDateTime(second, 'UTC') AS bucket
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT region, cloud_provider FROM benchmark_dirty_minutes
       UNION DISTINCT SELECT region, cloud_provider FROM benchmark_subscriber_locations
       UNION DISTINCT SELECT tupleElement(r, 1), tupleElement(r, 2)
       FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(rollup_generations) AS r))
 ARRAY JOIN range(toUInt32(toStartOfMinute(greatest($__fromTime_ms, now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR))), greatest(toUInt32(toStartOfMinute(greatest($__fromTime_ms, now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR))), toUInt32(toStartOfMinute($__toTime_ms)) + 60), 60) AS second
 WHERE (region, cloud_provider, bucket) NOT IN (SELECT tupleElement(r, 1), tupleElement(r, 2), tupleElement(r, 3) FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(rollup_generations) AS r))
 AND (region, cloud_provider, bucket) NOT IN (SELECT region, cloud_provider, bucket FROM benchmark_dirty_minutes
 WHERE bucket >= toStartOfMinute($__fromTime_ms) AND bucket <= toStartOfMinute($__toTime_ms)
 GROUP BY region, cloud_provider, bucket HAVING sum(expected) > sum(revision) OR sum(incomplete) > 0))
 GROUP BY region, cloud_provider, subscription_id, data_type, commitment, provider) GROUP BY subscription_id, data_type
), metadata AS (
 SELECT subscription_id, argMax(filters, registered_utc) AS filters
 FROM benchmark_subscription_versions
 WHERE (${data_type:sqlstring} = '__all' OR data_type = ${data_type:sqlstring}) AND commitment = ${commitment:sqlstring}
 GROUP BY subscription_id
), configurations AS (
 SELECT observed.*, metadata.filters AS filters,
 extractAll(metadata.filters, '"([^"]+)"') AS addresses,
 extract(metadata.filters, ';window=([^;]+)') AS window_setting,
 replaceAll(replaceRegexpAll(extract(metadata.filters, ';providers=([^;]+)'), '@[0-9a-f]+', ''), ',', ', ') AS provider_names,
 concat(multiIf(empty(metadata.filters), concat('Configuration ', substring(observed.subscription_id, 1, 8)),
   observed.data_type = 'slot', 'Slot updates',
   concat(if(observed.data_type = 'account', 'Account owner: ', 'Transactions include: '),
     if(empty(addresses), 'all', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(address ->
       concat(substring(address, 1, 6), '…', substring(address, -4)), arraySlice(addresses, 1, 3)), ', ')),
     if(length(addresses) > 3, concat(' +', toString(length(addresses) - 3), ' more'), ''))),
   if(window_setting = '', '', concat(' · window ', window_setting)),
   if(provider_names = '', '', concat(' · ', provider_names)))
 AS configuration
 FROM observed LEFT JOIN metadata ON observed.subscription_id = metadata.subscription_id
)
 SELECT subscription_id AS value,
 concat(configuration, ' · ', formatDateTime(last_seen, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S'), ' UTC') AS label
 FROM configurations WHERE ${data_type:sqlstring} != '__all'
 ORDER BY last_seen DESC, subscription_id DESC)

 SELECT region, cloud_provider, subscription_id, data_type, commitment, event_id,
 groupArray(tuple(provider, first_seen, last_seen, delivered, missed, lag, bytes)) providers
 FROM per_provider GROUP BY region, cloud_provider, subscription_id, data_type, commitment, event_id
), expanded AS (
 SELECT region, cloud_provider, subscription_id, data_type, commitment,
 arrayCount(p -> p.4 = 1 OR p.5 = 1, providers) >= 2
   AND arrayCount(p -> p.4 = 1 AND p.6 = 0, providers) = 1 eligible,
 arrayJoin(arrayConcat(
   arrayMap(p -> tuple('provider', p.1, '', p.2, p.3, p.4, p.5, p.6,
     toUInt8(eligible AND p.4 = 1 AND p.6 = 0), toUInt8(0),
     toUInt8(p.4 = 1 AND data_type IN ('account', 'transaction')),
     toUInt8(p.4 = 1 AND data_type IN ('account', 'transaction') AND isNull(p.7)),
     if(p.4 = 1 AND data_type IN ('account', 'transaction'), ifNull(p.7, 0), toUInt64(0))), providers),
   arrayFlatten(arrayMap(a -> arrayMap(b ->
     tuple('pair', a.1, b.1, a.2, a.3, toUInt8(a.4 = 1 AND b.4 = 1), toUInt8(0),
       if(a.4 = 1 AND b.4 = 1, a.6 - b.6, 0),
       toUInt8(a.4 = 1 AND (b.4 = 0 OR a.6 < b.6)), toUInt8(b.4 = 1 AND (a.4 = 0 OR a.6 > b.6)),
       toUInt8(0), toUInt8(0), toUInt64(0)),
     arrayFilter(b -> b.1 != a.1 AND (b.4 = 1 OR b.5 = 1) AND (a.4 = 1 OR b.4 = 1), providers)),
     arrayFilter(a -> a.4 = 1 OR a.5 = 1, providers)))
 )) row
 FROM events
)
SELECT toStartOfMinute(row.4) AS bucket, toUInt64(0) AS generation, region, cloud_provider, subscription_id, data_type, commitment,
 row.1 kind, row.2 provider, row.3 other_provider,
 min(row.4) AS first_seen, max(row.5) AS last_seen, count() AS observations, sum(row.6) AS delivered, sum(row.7) AS missed, sum(row.9) AS wins, sum(row.10) AS losses,
 sum(toInt128(if(row.6 = 1, row.8, 0))) AS lag_sum, sum(row.11) AS byte_events, sum(row.12) AS unknown_bytes, sum(row.13) AS message_bytes,
 quantilesTDigestIfState(0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.5, 0.95, 0.99, 0.999)(row.8, row.6) AS percentiles
FROM expanded
GROUP BY bucket, region, cloud_provider, subscription_id, data_type, commitment, kind, provider, other_provider) WHERE kind = 'provider' AND provider IN (${provider_a:sqlstring}, ${provider_b:sqlstring})
 GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time) WHERE (($__interval_s >= 60 AND modulo($__interval_s, 60) = 0) OR (dateDiff('second', $__fromTime_ms, $__toTime_ms) > 21600 OR $__fromTime_ms < now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR - INTERVAL 1 MINUTE)))
 SETTINGS max_threads = 16, max_memory_usage = 6000000000, max_execution_time = 45,
 max_bytes_before_external_group_by = 2000000000, max_bytes_before_external_sort = 1000000000

panels.description: Events each provider did not deliver within the configured window after the first provider’s delivery while connected, per second, including unpaired events. Deliveries after that window still count as missed deadlines. Gaps mean no observations.

options.content:
**Resolution:** ten-second detail for the latest six hours; minute summaries for longer or older views. Overview percentiles are exact up to one hour and approximate for longer views. Counts and wins stay exact. Ranges older than six hours are widened to whole minutes at their edges (raw detail has expired). Summary, connection and health history retain 30 days.

Compare **${provider_a} (A)** and **${provider_b} (B)** for the same region, cloud provider and subscription. We compare **the same event delivered on time by both providers**. **All** pools account, transaction and slot events, using the latest configuration per stream.

**Missed deadline = not delivered within the configured window.** Each event opens the configured comparison window at the first provider’s delivery. A connected provider that has not delivered by then records a **missed deadline** for that event, even if its delivery arrives later. Events that missed the deadline are not part of the differences, but they count in win rates: delivering on time when the other provider misses the deadline is a win.

**Downtime:** events while a provider is disconnected are excluded from the comparison, not counted as missed deadlines. The **downtime** cards show outages of at least 10 s, when reconnecting kept failing; quicker reconnects are not downtime.

The difference is **${provider_a} arrival time − ${provider_b} arrival time**, in milliseconds. **Negative** means ${provider_a} arrived earlier; **positive** means ${provider_b} arrived earlier.

Sort these signed differences from smallest to largest: **p5** is the 5th percentile, **p50** is the median (half the differences are below it, half above), and **p95** is the 95th percentile. **p0.1** is the 0.1st percentile. These describe arrival differences, not a provider’s win rate.

**Illustrative examples (not live readings):**

- **p5 = −10 ms:** for roughly 5% of paired events, ${provider_a} arrived at least 10 ms before ${provider_b}.
- **p95 = +20 ms:** roughly 95% of differences are at or below +20 ms; the remaining 5% are events where ${provider_a} arrived more than 20 ms after ${provider_b}.

The cards summarize the **selected time range**; the graph calculates percentiles for **each time bucket**. **Avg** is the mean signed difference. Each win rate is **that provider’s wins / (${provider_a} wins + ${provider_b} wins)**.

targets.rawSql:
WITH (SELECT groupArray(tuple(region, cloud_provider, bucket, generation)) FROM (SELECT c.region, c.cloud_provider, c.bucket, c.generation FROM
 (SELECT region, cloud_provider, bucket, max(commits.generation) generation, argMax(commits.revision, commits.generation) revision
  FROM benchmark_rollup_commits AS commits
  WHERE bucket + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE > $__fromTime_ms AND bucket < $__toTime_ms
  AND ((bucket >= $__fromTime_ms AND bucket + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE <= $__toTime_ms) OR bucket < now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR) GROUP BY region, cloud_provider, bucket) c
 LEFT JOIN (SELECT region, cloud_provider, bucket, sum(revision) revision, sum(expected) expected, sum(incomplete) incomplete FROM benchmark_dirty_minutes
  WHERE bucket + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE > $__fromTime_ms AND bucket < $__toTime_ms
  AND ((bucket >= $__fromTime_ms AND bucket + INTERVAL 1 MINUTE <= $__toTime_ms) OR bucket < now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR) GROUP BY region, cloud_provider, bucket) d
 ON c.region = d.region AND c.cloud_provider = d.cloud_provider AND c.bucket = d.bucket
 WHERE c.revision >= d.revision AND d.revision >= d.expected AND d.incomplete = 0)) AS rollup_generations
 SELECT * FROM (WITH observed AS (
 SELECT subscription_id, data_type, min(first_seen) AS first_seen, max(last_seen) AS last_seen
 FROM (SELECT region, cloud_provider, subscription_id, data_type, commitment, provider,
 first_seen, last_seen FROM benchmark_minute_rollups
 WHERE kind = 'provider' AND region = ${region:sqlstring} AND cloud_provider = ${cloud_provider:sqlstring}
 AND (${data_type:sqlstring} = '__all' OR data_type = ${data_type:sqlstring}) AND commitment = ${commitment:sqlstring} AND (region, cloud_provider, bucket, generation) IN (SELECT tupleElement(r, 1), tupleElement(r, 2), tupleElement(r, 3), tupleElement(r, 4)
 FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(rollup_generations) AS r))
 UNION ALL
 SELECT region, cloud_provider, subscription_id, data_type, commitment, provider,
 min(event_utc) AS first_seen, max(event_utc) AS last_seen
 FROM benchmark_event_lags WHERE region = ${region:sqlstring} AND cloud_provider = ${cloud_provider:sqlstring}
 AND (${data_type:sqlstring} = '__all' OR data_type = ${data_type:sqlstring}) AND commitment = ${commitment:sqlstring} AND $__timeFilter_ms(event_utc) AND (region, cloud_provider, toStartOfMinute(event_utc)) IN (
 SELECT region, cloud_provider, toDateTime(second, 'UTC') AS bucket
 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT region, cloud_provider FROM benchmark_dirty_minutes
       UNION DISTINCT SELECT region, cloud_provider FROM benchmark_subscriber_locations
       UNION DISTINCT SELECT tupleElement(r, 1), tupleElement(r, 2)
       FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(rollup_generations) AS r))
 ARRAY JOIN range(toUInt32(toStartOfMinute(greatest($__fromTime_ms, now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR))), greatest(toUInt32(toStartOfMinute(greatest($__fromTime_ms, now() - INTERVAL 6 HOUR))), toUInt32(toStartOfMinute($__toTime_ms)) + 60), 60) AS second
 WHERE (region, cloud_provider, bucket) NOT IN (SELECT tupleElement(r, 1), tupleElement(r, 2), tupleElement(r, 3) FROM (SELECT arrayJoin(rollup_generations) AS r))
 AND (region, cloud_provider, bucket) NOT IN (SELECT region, cloud_provider, bucket FROM benchmark_dirty_minutes
 WHERE bucket >= toStartOfMinute($__fromTime_ms) AND bucket <= toStartOfMinute($__toTime_ms)
 GROUP BY region, cloud_provider, bucket HAVING sum(expected) > sum(revision) OR sum(incomplete) > 0))
 GROUP BY region, cloud_provider, subscription_id, data_type, commitment, provider) GROUP BY subscription_id, data_type
), metadata AS (
 SELECT subscription_id, argMax(filters, registered_utc) AS filters
 FROM benchmark_subscription_versions
 WHERE (${data_type:sqlstring} = '__all' OR data_type = ${data_type:sqlstring}) AND commitment = ${commitment:sqlstring}
 GROUP BY subscription_id
), configurations AS (
 SELECT observed.*, metadata.filters AS filters,
 extractAll(metadata.filters, '"([^"]+)"') AS addresses,
 extract(metadata.filters, ';window=([^;]+)') AS window_setting,
 replaceAll(replaceRegexpAll(extract(metadata.filters, ';providers=([^;]+)'), '@[0-9a-f]+', ''), ',', ', ') AS provider_names,
 concat(multiIf(empty(metadata.filters), concat('Configuration ', substring(observed.subscription_id, 1, 8)),
   observed.data_type = 'slot', 'Slot updates',
   concat(if(observed.data_type = 'account', 'Account owner: ', 'Transactions include: '),
     if(empty(addresses), 'all', arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(address ->
       concat(substring(address, 1, 6), '…', substring(address, -4)), arraySlice(addresses, 1, 3)), ', ')),
     if(length(addresses) > 3, concat(' +', toString(length(addresses) - 3), ' more'), ''))),
   if(window_setting = '', '', concat(' · window ', window_setting)),
   if(provider_names = '', '', concat(' · ', provider_names)))
 AS configuration
 FROM observed LEFT JOIN metadata ON observed.subscription_id = metadata.subscription_id
)
 SELECT data_type AS stream, configuration, first_seen, last_seen, filters, subscription_id
 FROM configurations ORDER BY data_type, last_seen DESC, subscription_id DESC)
